column1: # Deskripsi/bio karakter di arsip (GunCharacterData f11 + GunData f6) — 65 bio.
# Tetap Inggris: nama karakter & julukan, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud, Imprint Model,
# AR Team, H.I.D.E. 404, Task Force DEFY, Monsoon, Zucchero, Sparkle Squad, Griffin,
# Sangvis Ferri Manufacturing, Sweeper, Ouka Kyuso, Orlog Conglomerate, Prism,
# Elmo, Yellow Zone, Guo Bao Rou, M4, AK-12, Rush B.
# Commander -> "Komandan" (sebutan, bukan nama).
# CATATAN ESCAPE: \n = baris baru sungguhan; \\n = dua karakter backslash+n
# yang memang ada di teks game. Jangan tukar keduanya.

A tactical Doll who is outwardly cold but possesses a delicate heart. While she might seem to agree with others without much thought, the truth is that she takes their opinions to heart and tries her best to satisfy them. She notices little details and reactions often overlooked by others, and she is quite sensitive to her surroundings. However, this also leads to her being influenced easily by the environment. \\n"I once thought time would change many things... However, it seems you haven't changed, and neither have we... It is only the world that changes every day."
column2: Doll taktis yang tampak dingin di luar tapi punya hati yang halus. Dia terlihat mengiyakan orang lain tanpa banyak berpikir, padahal sebenarnya dia menyimpan pendapat mereka baik-baik dan berusaha sekuat tenaga memenuhinya. Dia menangkap detail dan reaksi kecil yang luput dari orang lain, dan cukup peka terhadap sekitarnya. Sayangnya, itu pula yang membuatnya gampang terpengaruh lingkungan. \\n"Dulu kukira waktu akan mengubah banyak hal... Tapi ternyata kau tidak berubah, kami pun tidak... Hanya dunia yang berubah setiap hari."

column1: A gentle, approachable Doll. Although she has performance limitations, she does not indulge in self-pity, but instead proactively searches for a place she can call home. A Doll who embraces and accommodates everyone around her, she has become a source of refuge for others without realizing it.
column2: Doll yang lembut dan mudah didekati. Meski performanya terbatas, dia tidak larut mengasihani diri, malah aktif mencari tempat yang bisa dia sebut rumah. Doll yang merangkul dan menerima semua orang di sekitarnya, tanpa sadar dia sudah jadi tempat berteduh bagi yang lain.

column1: As a member of the AR Team, she is now much calmer and more composed than in the past. After experiencing M4's departure and separating from the Commander, she has come to cherish the comrades around her even more. She is results-oriented and doesn't care much about the process; coupled with her taciturn nature and dislike for making excuses, she often incurs misunderstandings. It is often only after she has silently given a lot that everyone realizes her good intentions. And this is her unique, gentle way of treating others.
column2: Sebagai anggota AR Team, dia kini jauh lebih tenang dan mantap dibanding dulu. Setelah mengalami kepergian M4 dan berpisah dari Komandan, dia jadi makin menghargai rekan-rekan di sekitarnya. Dia berorientasi hasil dan kurang peduli pada prosesnya; ditambah sifatnya yang irit bicara dan enggan beralasan, dia sering disalahpahami. Biasanya baru setelah dia diam-diam memberi banyak, orang-orang sadar akan niat baiknya. Dan begitulah caranya yang khas dan lembut dalam memperlakukan orang lain.

column1: The first impression she gives others is that of an impatient Doll, often getting anxious when communicating with others. This only gets more obvious after her words are misunderstood, sometimes driving her to her wits' end and causing her to hyperfocus on irrelevant issues. However, this is simply because she doesn't know how to properly express herself. Those who take the time to understand her will come to realize how sensitive and careful she is, as well as her perfectionist attitude toward her work. \\n"...Keep smiling, don't glare at people, keep smiling... I must look really fierce now, don't I? I'm still learning how to smile, so please be patient."
column2: Kesan pertama yang dia berikan adalah Doll yang tidak sabaran, sering gelisah saat berkomunikasi dengan orang lain. Itu makin kentara begitu ucapannya disalahpahami, kadang membuatnya kehabisan akal dan malah terpaku pada hal-hal yang tidak penting. Padahal itu semata karena dia tidak tahu cara mengungkapkan diri dengan benar. Mereka yang mau meluangkan waktu memahaminya akan sadar betapa peka dan telitinya dia, juga sikap perfeksionisnya dalam bekerja. \\n"...Terus tersenyum, jangan melotot, terus tersenyum... Aku pasti kelihatan galak sekali sekarang, ya? Aku masih belajar tersenyum, jadi tolong sabar sedikit."

column1: It's hard to sum up Basti's past in a single word. To those in power, it's a criminal record. In the criminal underworld, it's a horror story. And to the Commander, it's a touching love letter.\n"Darling, do you want to know my secrets? This just won't do; you'll have to be bolder, more forward—"
column2: Sulit merangkum masa lalu Basti dalam satu kata. Bagi para penguasa, itu catatan kriminal. Di dunia bawah tanah, itu cerita horor. Dan bagi Komandan, itu surat cinta yang mengharukan.\n"Sayang, kau mau tahu rahasiaku? Wah, begitu tidak boleh; kau harus lebih berani, lebih agresif—"

column1: Her innocence, liveliness, and harmless little scheming are written on her face. Absolutely loyal to the Commander and her big sister, she is a Doll who strives to become an elite Doll loved by everyone. With her around, awkward silences are no longer a thing!
column2: Kepolosan, keceriaan, dan akal bulus kecilnya yang tak berbahaya terbaca jelas di wajahnya. Setia mutlak pada Komandan dan kakaknya, dia Doll yang berjuang menjadi Doll elite yang disayangi semua orang. Selama ada dia, hening canggung tidak akan pernah terjadi lagi!

column1: A humble yet principled Doll. She brews aromatic coffee and stands as the steadfast guardian of the café—she is the irreplaceable shield of "Zucchero".
column2: Doll yang rendah hati tapi teguh prinsip. Dia menyeduh kopi yang harum dan berdiri sebagai penjaga setia kafe itu—dialah perisai "Zucchero" yang tak tergantikan.

column1: This Doll with a ceaseless fountain of inspiration is Griffin's Queen of Inventions. Undeterred by countless setbacks, her mind churns out a whirlwind of quirky, headache-inducing ideas. Yet, when the moment demands it, she always manages to come up with ingenious solutions.
column2: Doll dengan sumber inspirasi yang tak pernah kering ini adalah Ratu Penemuan-nya Griffin. Tak gentar oleh kegagalan yang tak terhitung, kepalanya terus memuntahkan badai ide nyeleneh yang bikin pusing. Tapi saat keadaan menuntut, dia selalu berhasil melahirkan solusi jenius.

column1: A reserved and cautious Tactical Doll, she is introverted, bad at expressing herself, and gets embarrassed easily. Although it isn't related to her current job, she retains a tireless drive to explore unknown fields and dabble in various skills. This passion is hidden deep beneath her calm appearance, like a buried treasure, and only a Commander with keen insight can discover her unique brilliance. \n"...I just know a little, there's no need to praise me... I'm just an ordinary Tactical Doll."
column2: Tactical Doll yang pendiam dan berhati-hati, tertutup, payah mengungkapkan diri, dan gampang salah tingkah. Meski tak ada kaitannya dengan pekerjaannya sekarang, dia punya dorongan tak kenal lelah untuk menjelajahi bidang yang asing dan mencoba berbagai keterampilan. Gairah itu tersembunyi jauh di balik penampilannya yang tenang, bagai harta terpendam, dan hanya Komandan dengan mata jeli yang bisa menemukan kilaunya yang khas. \n"...Aku cuma tahu sedikit, tidak usah dipuji... Aku cuma Tactical Doll biasa."

column1: Although she often appears cheerful and enthusiastic, her face can sometimes take on a completely different, cold expression. The syringe in her hand—is it meant to save lives, or take them?
column2: Meski sering tampak ceria dan bersemangat, wajahnya kadang berubah menjadi ekspresi dingin yang sama sekali berbeda. Jarum suntik di tangannya—untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, atau merenggutnya?

column1: A gentle and reserved Doll who roams the lands with her guzheng and her bandmates from "Monsoon". When she plucks the strings, she evokes the deepest desires buried in the hearts of her listeners—listening to all, and embracing all.
column2: Doll yang lembut dan pendiam, mengembara bersama guzheng-nya dan rekan-rekan sebandnya dari "Monsoon". Saat dia memetik senar, dia membangkitkan hasrat terdalam yang terpendam di hati para pendengarnya—mendengarkan semua, merangkul semua.

column1: A highly sensitive Doll who has lost her neural records, persistently searching for her past and wholeheartedly fulfilling the requests of others. The way she expresses her emotions can be both somewhat exaggerated and immature, often leaving others puzzled in her wake. In truth, these mannerisms are simply a way to mask her own awkwardness and insecurities.
column2: Doll yang sangat peka dan kehilangan rekaman sarafnya, gigih mencari masa lalunya sambil sepenuh hati memenuhi permintaan orang lain. Cara dia mengungkapkan perasaan cenderung berlebihan dan kekanakan, sering membuat orang di sekitarnya bingung. Padahal semua tingkah itu sekadar cara menutupi kecanggungan dan rasa tidak amannya sendiri.

column1: Faelynn's memories are piled high with painful and oppressive secrets, yet her neural cloud still reveals a touch of brightness, because every dark cloud is illuminated by the warm sun of innocence.\n'Master, no matter how long you leave, I... I will obediently wait for you to come home!'
column2: Ingatan Faelynn menumpuk penuh rahasia yang menyakitkan dan menekan, tapi Neural cloud-nya tetap memancarkan secercah terang, karena setiap awan kelam disinari mentari hangat kepolosan.\n'Tuan, seberapa lama pun kau pergi, aku... aku akan menunggumu pulang dengan patuh!'

column1: A Doll whose appearance contrasts greatly with her personality. Small in stature yet imposing, she carries a gun in one hand and an axe in another, creating a presence that would scare off most people. However, if you are willing to look past her appearance and get to understand her better, you will find that, behind her intolerant expression and irritable tone lies a delicate, sensitive soul. She too, is awaiting your warmth.
column2: Doll yang penampilannya sangat bertolak belakang dengan sifatnya. Bertubuh kecil tapi berwibawa, dia menenteng senapan di satu tangan dan kapak di tangan lain, menghadirkan aura yang bikin kebanyakan orang mundur. Tapi kalau kau mau melihat melampaui penampilannya dan mengenalnya lebih jauh, kau akan menemukan jiwa yang halus dan peka di balik ekspresi ketusnya dan nada bicaranya yang gampang tersulut. Dia pun sedang menanti kehangatanmu.

column1: A medical Doll who craves excitement and amusement, she's extremely forward and given to coquetry. Both her medical and pharmaceutical techniques are top-notch, but her personality often makes her passion hard to bear.\n"Now, which would you prefer? This pill, this syringe, or my punishment? All of them will make you feel reeeeeally good~"
column2: Doll medis yang haus sensasi dan hiburan, sangat agresif dan gemar menggoda. Kemampuan medis dan farmasinya kelas atas, tapi kepribadiannya sering membuat gairahnya sulit ditanggung.\n"Nah, kau pilih yang mana? Pil ini, suntikan ini, atau hukumanku? Semuanya akan membuatmu merasa enaaaak sekali~"

column1: A mature and composed elite Doll, she is undeniably the squad's core. Despite the squad members' diverse personalities, she seamlessly unites their strengths. With her presence, nothing will become a problem.
column2: Doll elite yang dewasa dan tenang, tak diragukan lagi inti dari regunya. Meski kepribadian anggota regunya beragam, dia menyatukan kelebihan mereka tanpa cela. Selama ada dia, tidak ada yang akan jadi masalah.

column1: She's a member of H.I.D.E. 404's Team B, providing powerful technical support. While she appears shy and timid at first blush, the fact that she sees things through to the end was an important factor in becoming a member of 404 in the first place. Despite preferring safety and security, she constantly hones her professional skills and works hard to overcome her weaknesses. Why not give this little kitten some encouragement with a pat on the head?
column2: Dia anggota Team B H.I.D.E. 404, pemberi dukungan teknis yang tangguh. Sekilas dia tampak pemalu dan penakut, tapi justru sifatnya yang selalu menuntaskan apa pun sampai akhir itulah yang membuatnya bisa jadi anggota 404 sejak awal. Meski lebih suka aman dan tenang, dia terus mengasah keahlian profesionalnya dan berjuang keras mengatasi kelemahannya. Bagaimana kalau beri kucing kecil ini semangat dengan usapan di kepala?

column1: Kind and gentle in appearance, she is also highly skilled at manipulating rules and exploiting loopholes to get what she wants. With her great insight, she's able to easily pierce the facades of humans and read their hearts. She tends to use pranks to close the distance to the people near her, guide others to realizations about themselves, and help them overcome their weaknesses. When necessary, she will gladly sacrifice herself to protect the people who are precious to her.
column2: Terlihat baik dan lembut, tapi dia juga sangat piawai memainkan aturan dan memanfaatkan celah demi mendapatkan yang dia mau. Dengan ketajaman pandangannya, dia gampang menembus topeng manusia dan membaca isi hatinya. Dia suka memakai keisengan untuk mendekatkan diri pada orang di sekitarnya, menuntun mereka menyadari sesuatu tentang diri sendiri, dan membantu mereka mengatasi kelemahannya. Kalau perlu, dia rela mengorbankan diri demi melindungi orang-orang yang berharga baginya.

column1: A lively and enthusiastic Doll who follows in her older sister's footsteps with a carefree spirit. She roams the lands with her bandmates, bringing fresh and fiery notes to "Monsoon".
column2: Doll yang lincah dan bersemangat, mengikuti jejak kakaknya dengan jiwa yang bebas. Dia mengembara bersama rekan sebandnya, membawa nada-nada segar dan membara ke "Monsoon".

column1: Elegant and composed; a Doll brimming with confidence. She aspires to make every member of H.I.D.E. 404 into an elite. Only those who are familiar with her know the tenderness that lies behind her cold, strong-willed demeanor.
column2: Anggun dan tenang; Doll yang meluap percaya diri. Dia bercita-cita menjadikan setiap anggota H.I.D.E. 404 seorang elite. Hanya mereka yang akrab dengannya yang tahu kelembutan di balik sikapnya yang dingin dan berkemauan keras.

column1: The former Alpha Wolf of DEFY. After experiencing the worst day, she took responsibility and led her comrades in standing their final watch. In the end, she handed over the responsibilities and title of leader to a trusted companion, choosing another way to continue fighting. To this day, she is still the AK-12 you know, but be very careful—she is even more dangerous now.\n'An excellent snow wolf uses the snow to hide itself. But I am even better—even dressed all in white, I can vanish into the darkness.'
column2: Mantan Alpha Wolf DEFY. Setelah melewati hari terburuknya, dia memikul tanggung jawab dan memimpin rekan-rekannya menjalani penjagaan terakhir. Pada akhirnya, dia menyerahkan tanggung jawab dan gelar pemimpin pada rekan yang dia percaya, memilih jalan lain untuk terus bertempur. Sampai hari ini dia tetap AK-12 yang kau kenal, tapi hati-hati—dia sekarang jauh lebih berbahaya.\n'Serigala salju yang hebat memakai salju untuk menyembunyikan diri. Tapi aku lebih hebat lagi—meski berbalut putih seluruhnya, aku bisa lenyap ke dalam kegelapan.'

column1: She has a bit of a temper and shows little interest in matters unrelated to herself, but her sense of responsibility is beyond reproach. Even if she is assigned a mission she absolutely detests, such as "serving as Nemesis' exclusive translator", she will still give it her all.
column2: Dia agak temperamental dan kurang peduli pada urusan yang tak menyangkut dirinya, tapi rasa tanggung jawabnya tak tercela. Sekalipun diberi misi yang benar-benar dia benci, seperti "menjadi penerjemah khusus Nemesis", dia tetap mengerjakannya sekuat tenaga.

column1: A Doll with an unusual obsession with making money, she finds a sense of security by working hard to earn it and then spending it all. However, the time she spends working with her reliable companions is equally her treasure.
column2: Doll dengan obsesi tidak wajar pada uang, dia menemukan rasa aman dengan bekerja keras mengumpulkannya lalu menghabiskannya. Meski begitu, waktu yang dia habiskan bekerja bersama rekan-rekan yang bisa diandalkan sama berharganya baginya.

column1: A Doll who was "reborn" from Leva's neural logs, she's a little ball of sunshine and a decisive, resilient fighter. While her looks and personality are practically the same as the Doll she was modeled on, Lainie knows that her simulated past doesn't define her, and her future holds limitless possibilities. There is plenty of empty space in her neural cloud, just waiting to be filled with new experiences. She wants to cherish her bonds with Leva, you, and everyone else.\\n"Commander, let's go out and get some sun today~"
column2: Doll yang "terlahir kembali" dari catatan saraf Leva, dia bola kecil penuh sinar sekaligus petarung yang tegas dan tangguh. Meski rupa dan sifatnya nyaris sama dengan Doll yang jadi modelnya, Lainie tahu masa lalu simulasinya tidak menentukan dirinya, dan masa depannya menyimpan kemungkinan tanpa batas. Masih banyak ruang kosong di Neural cloud-nya, menunggu diisi pengalaman baru. Dia ingin menjaga ikatannya dengan Leva, denganmu, dan dengan semua orang.\\n"Komandan, ayo keluar dan berjemur hari ini~"

column1: A cheerful and friendly Doll who goes to great lengths to protect her cherished family. Over time, she has become more composed and developed a perfect smile when interacting with others. She also "forcibly" gives her family heartfelt hugs whenever she sees them.
column2: Doll yang ceria dan bersahabat, rela berbuat apa saja demi melindungi keluarga yang dia sayangi. Seiring waktu dia jadi lebih tenang dan mengembangkan senyum sempurna saat berhadapan dengan orang lain. Dia juga "memaksa" memeluk keluarganya sepenuh hati setiap kali bertemu.

column1: If you think the Doll you're looking at is kind and friendly, then you're one foot into her trap already. If you don't realize it in time, then Leva's not going to take responsibility for anything you lose as a result... Unless it's you.\n"Commander, are you trying to set yourself up for a loss here? Hehe♪ I don't mind, though. So how do you intend to have me take responsibility for you, hm?"
column2: Kalau kau mengira Doll di depanmu ini baik dan ramah, satu kakimu sudah masuk perangkapnya. Kalau kau tidak sadar tepat waktu, Leva tidak akan bertanggung jawab atas apa pun yang kau kehilangan gara-gara itu... Kecuali kalau yang hilang itu dirimu sendiri.\n"Komandan, kau sengaja mau merugi ya? Hehe♪ Aku sih tidak keberatan. Jadi, kau mau aku bertanggung jawab atas dirimu bagaimana, hm?"

column1: A pure-hearted and innocent Tactical Doll who forever holds on to a childlike heart. She's incredibly strong and can't keep her hands off all things cute. Despite being a celebrity in the world of toys and collectibles, Lewis doesn't crave recognition or personal gain; she cares only about bringing joy to others and protecting the smiles of children. As a toymaker, she wants to pass on happiness to the future through her toy designs, and as a Tactical Doll, she defends that future with her weapon.
column2: Tactical Doll berhati bersih dan polos yang selamanya menjaga hati kanak-kanaknya. Tenaganya luar biasa dan tangannya tidak bisa berhenti menggamit apa pun yang lucu. Meski jadi selebritas di dunia mainan dan koleksi, Lewis tidak haus pengakuan atau keuntungan pribadi; yang dia pedulikan hanya membawa kebahagiaan bagi orang lain dan menjaga senyum anak-anak. Sebagai pembuat mainan, dia ingin mewariskan kebahagiaan ke masa depan lewat rancangan mainannya, dan sebagai Tactical Doll, dia menjaga masa depan itu dengan senjatanya.

column1: A Doll with a prickly exterior but who has a sensitive soul. She often ends up forcing herself to do things she's poor at and hating herself as a result. She enjoys listening to late-night radio channels, and gets extremely irritable if she doesn't replenish her sugar levels in time. She hates violence, but considers weapons to be civilized and effective problem-solving tools, so using a gun doesn't fall under that definition.\n"Consuming too much sugar will make me malfunction, but I'll scrap myself on the spot if I don't get any right now, so I guess I should have some... Nom. Want some too, Commander?"
column2: Doll berduri di luar tapi berjiwa peka. Dia sering memaksakan diri melakukan hal yang tidak dia kuasai lalu berakhir membenci dirinya sendiri. Dia suka mendengarkan siaran radio larut malam, dan jadi sangat mudah tersulut kalau kadar gulanya tidak segera diisi ulang. Dia benci kekerasan, tapi menganggap senjata sebagai alat pemecah masalah yang beradab dan efektif, jadi memakai senapan tidak masuk kategori itu.\n"Kebanyakan gula bikin aku error, tapi kalau tidak dapat sekarang juga aku bisa merongsokkan diri di tempat, jadi kurasa aku harus makan sedikit... Nyam. Mau juga, Komandan?"

column1: An extremely introverted doll who needs to communicate through writing. She is meticulous and thorough, playing a "strategist" role in the team. After switching to a new Imprint Model, she has become even more reliable, supporting her teammates' dreams daily.
column2: Doll yang sangat tertutup dan harus berkomunikasi lewat tulisan. Dia teliti dan menyeluruh, memerankan "ahli strategi" di tim. Setelah beralih ke Imprint Model baru, dia jadi makin bisa diandalkan, menopang mimpi rekan-rekannya setiap hari.

column1: She's a Doll who's gentle and polite, kind yet resilient. She seems to have no grasp of prices or arithmetic at all, which means just about everything she uses costs a bomb. She's well-known for being a rich girl, but she is also extremely generous, because she believes that unreservedly distributing her wealth to others is her natural responsibility.\n"Welcome back, Commander! Um... Do you have any expenses that need covering?"
column2: Doll yang lembut dan sopan, baik hati sekaligus tangguh. Dia tampaknya sama sekali tidak paham harga maupun hitung-hitungan, jadi hampir semua yang dia pakai harganya selangit. Dia terkenal sebagai anak orang kaya, tapi juga sangat dermawan, karena dia yakin membagikan kekayaannya tanpa perhitungan adalah tanggung jawab alaminya.\n"Selamat datang kembali, Komandan! Umm... Ada pengeluaran yang perlu ditanggung?"

column1: Beneath her mysterious and elegant exterior hides a fathomless and bold desire. Nobody can tell what she is thinking; or perhaps her true feelings are reserved for a certain someone. \n"Hehehe, are you really that interested in probing my personal files? If you'd like to know more about me, then you should come ask me in person. I will bare everything to you, in thorough, exacting detail... holding nothing back."
column2: Di balik penampilannya yang misterius dan anggun tersembunyi hasrat yang berani dan tak terduga dalamnya. Tak seorang pun bisa menebak isi pikirannya; atau mungkin perasaan sejatinya memang disimpan untuk satu orang tertentu. \n"Hehehe, kau benar-benar setertarik itu mengorek berkas pribadiku? Kalau mau tahu lebih banyak tentangku, datang dan tanyakan langsung padaku. Akan kubuka semuanya untukmu, sedetail dan seteliti mungkin... tanpa kusembunyikan sedikit pun."

column1: This Doll, who is both exceedingly shy and cautious, has a knack for noticing subtle details that others miss. Do keep in mind that her slow and reserved nature when socializing may require some extra patience and understanding.
column2: Doll yang teramat pemalu sekaligus berhati-hati ini punya bakat menangkap detail halus yang luput dari orang lain. Ingat, sifatnya yang lambat dan tertutup saat bergaul mungkin butuh kesabaran dan pengertian ekstra.

column1: A calm, proud, yet awkward Doll who isn't good at expressing herself. She loves fluffy little animals and overly sweet macchiatos. Always a loner, her gaze often lingers somewhere. When will she finally get the response she's been longing for?
column2: Doll yang tenang, berharga diri tinggi, tapi canggung dan payah mengungkapkan diri. Dia suka binatang kecil berbulu halus dan macchiato yang kemanisan. Selalu menyendiri, pandangannya sering tertahan pada sesuatu. Kapan dia akhirnya akan mendapat jawaban yang dia nanti-nantikan?

column1: Kind, lively, and hardworking, she is the chief mechanic of the Elmo. Though occasional bouts of frustration over her unfair salary tinge her eyes red, they're easily soothed by a bottle of rice wine. Will she wake up in the refitting room again today?
column2: Baik hati, lincah, dan pekerja keras, dialah kepala mekanik Elmo. Meski sesekali matanya memerah karena kesal soal gajinya yang tidak adil, itu gampang diredakan sebotol arak beras. Apa hari ini dia akan bangun di ruang perakitan lagi?

column1: A Doll who approaches everything with peak laziness—except for gaming and reading manga. She's mastered the ultimate skill: falling asleep anytime, anywhere, under any circumstance. Although she seems to embody the philosophy of "lying flat" to the extreme, she reveals her dependable side in times of crisis—though in her words, "It'd be better if we just never ran into any 'crisis' at all…"
column2: Doll yang menghadapi segala hal dengan kemalasan tingkat dewa—kecuali main game dan baca manga. Dia sudah menguasai skill pamungkas: tertidur kapan saja, di mana saja, dalam keadaan apa saja. Meski tampak menjiwai filosofi "rebahan" sampai ke ubun-ubun, sisi andalnya muncul saat krisis—walau menurut dia sendiri, "Lebih enak lagi kalau kita tidak pernah ketemu 'krisis' sama sekali…"

column1: A lively girl who doesn't seem to have much presence. She likes hanging out in groups, but always ends up copying others and dislikes being alone. She does livestreams with Kuro when she has nothing to do, where her realistic impressions of others and natural ditziness have won her the audience's love. She sometimes does incomprehensible things in her daily life, but she's actually really good at getting along well with others and is always considerate of their feelings. During battle, she's always at the head of the pack, muttering some kind of weird incantation as she slashes through the enemy.\n“Rush B! GO GO GO!"
column2: Gadis lincah yang keberadaannya seakan kurang terasa. Dia suka nongkrong ramai-ramai, tapi selalu berakhir meniru orang lain dan tidak betah sendirian. Kalau sedang tidak ada kerjaan dia livestream bersama Kuro, dan tiruan suaranya yang mirip banget serta sifat ceroboh alaminya bikin penonton jatuh hati. Kadang dia melakukan hal-hal yang sulit dipahami dalam kesehariannya, tapi sebenarnya dia sangat pandai bergaul dan selalu memikirkan perasaan orang lain. Saat bertempur, dia selalu di barisan paling depan, menggumamkan semacam mantra aneh sambil menebas musuh.\n“Rush B! GO GO GO!"

column1: A Doll who loves to help others and strives to improve her negative mindset. Her motto is to never avoid challenges; once motivated, she gives her all. While negative thoughts may linger in her neural cloud, her radiant smile and enthusiastic actions surely inspire many of her companions.
column2: Doll yang senang menolong orang dan berjuang memperbaiki pola pikirnya yang negatif. Mottonya: jangan pernah menghindari tantangan; begitu semangatnya menyala, dia habis-habisan. Meski pikiran negatif mungkin masih menggantung di Neural cloud-nya, senyumnya yang berbinar dan tindakannya yang bersemangat pasti menyemangati banyak rekannya.

column1: A Doll who likes to play the mature grown-up, but looks up to heroes and also aspires to be one. Even after leaving the battlefield, she continues to shine as a security Doll, ensuring peaceful nights.
column2: Doll yang suka berlagak dewasa, tapi mengidolakan para pahlawan dan ingin jadi salah satunya. Bahkan setelah meninggalkan medan tempur, dia terus bersinar sebagai Doll keamanan, menjaga malam tetap damai.

column1: Passionate in mysticism and divination, she always carries a magical divination tool known as the "Prism". Her divination results are often expressed in a cryptic and enigmatic manner. Though she can be difficult to communicate with, she remains a dependable companion.
column2: Bergairah pada mistisisme dan ramalan, dia selalu membawa alat ramal ajaib bernama "Prism". Hasil ramalannya sering disampaikan dengan cara yang berteka-teki dan sulit ditebak. Meski susah diajak berkomunikasi, dia tetap rekan yang bisa diandalkan.

column1: After returning to her first body, Nemesis has not only awakened brand-new powers related to the future, but she has also regained the ability to speak normally—those words which were once incomprehensible are no longer barrier to understanding.\n"...The light is serene and the gentle winds call... Commander, would you like to hear today's predictions?"
column2: Setelah kembali ke tubuh pertamanya, Nemesis bukan hanya membangkitkan kekuatan baru yang berkaitan dengan masa depan, tapi juga memulihkan kemampuannya berbicara normal—kata-kata yang dulu tak terpahami kini bukan lagi penghalang.\n"...Cahayanya tenang dan angin lembut memanggil... Komandan, mau dengar ramalan hari ini?"

column1: A security officer who upholds justice, a kind older sister figure who cherishes children, a big spender who uses up all her monthly earnings—Who is to say that these three identities can't belong to the same person? Nikketa fights on the frontlines of justice, calmly demonstrating her values and beliefs. Yet when she faces you, another side of her emerges. "My work has taught me not to trust anyone. Boss is the exception though. We are fellow partners in the pursuit of justice."
column2: Petugas keamanan yang menegakkan keadilan, sosok kakak baik hati yang menyayangi anak-anak, pemboros yang menghabiskan seluruh gaji bulanannya—siapa bilang tiga identitas itu tidak bisa melekat pada satu orang? Nikketa bertempur di garis depan keadilan, dengan tenang menunjukkan nilai dan keyakinannya. Tapi saat berhadapan denganmu, sisi lain dirinya muncul. "Pekerjaanku mengajariku untuk tidak memercayai siapa pun. Tapi Bos pengecualian. Kita rekan sesama pengejar keadilan."

column1: This third-generation Doll is calm, serious, proud, and confident. Her modifications have granted her unparalleled power, making her even stronger tougher than before—enough to hide her uneasiness and vulnerability.\n"How did today's planning go? Would you mind telling me about it, Commander?"
column2: Doll generasi ketiga ini tenang, serius, berharga diri tinggi, dan percaya diri. Modifikasinya memberinya kekuatan tanpa tanding, membuatnya jauh lebih kuat dan liat dari sebelumnya—cukup untuk menutupi kegelisahan dan kerapuhannya.\n"Bagaimana perencanaan hari ini? Boleh ceritakan padaku, Komandan?"

column1: A warm-hearted Doll who doesn't know how to say "no", she has become a versatile helper through self-study in order to better handle any request. She is willing to give everything to protect everyone. When you encounter difficulties, feel free to rely on her—no matter what it is, Papasha will make it happen!
column2: Doll berhati hangat yang tidak tahu cara berkata "tidak", dia menjelma jadi pembantu serbabisa lewat belajar mandiri agar bisa menangani permintaan apa pun. Dia rela memberikan segalanya demi melindungi semua orang. Kalau kau menemui kesulitan, andalkan saja dia—apa pun itu, Papasha pasti mewujudkannya!

column1: A cute little Doll with big dreams, Peri has grown into a strong, independent Doll while following in the footsteps of her master. Her cheerful and lively personality has won the trust of many clients while her wits and experience have allowed her to avoid many pitfalls. All her efforts are to become a super cool and reliable Doll, so why not try relying on her a little?
column2: Doll mungil yang menggemaskan dengan mimpi besar, Peri tumbuh jadi Doll yang kuat dan mandiri sambil mengikuti jejak tuannya. Kepribadiannya yang ceria dan lincah memenangkan kepercayaan banyak klien, sementara kecerdikan dan pengalamannya membuatnya lolos dari banyak jebakan. Semua usahanya demi menjadi Doll yang super keren dan bisa diandalkan, jadi kenapa tidak coba sedikit mengandalkannya?

column1: Combat, survival, and a spectrum of emotions are all part of this vast world. Compared to the digital realm, she finds countless undiscovered pleasures in this expansive reality. Hm... that cloud has finally covered the sun. Time to lie down and rest for a while.
column2: Pertempuran, bertahan hidup, dan seluruh spektrum emosi semuanya bagian dari dunia yang luas ini. Dibanding alam digital, dia menemukan kenikmatan tak terhitung yang belum tersingkap di realitas seluas ini. Hm... awan itu akhirnya menutupi matahari. Saatnya rebahan dan istirahat sebentar.

column1: Gentle and accepting like the spring wind, sharp and aloof, like cold steel; the former is called Phaetusa, while the latter is Sweeper. Of these two souls who inhabit the same frame, one is humanity's finest guardian, while the other is a fighting corpse from Sangvis Ferri Manufacturing. \nThey met amidst the flames of war and saved each other, and they have decided to join hands and carve their own path through this tumultuous era.
column2: Lembut dan menerima bagai angin musim semi, tajam dan menjaga jarak bagai baja dingin; yang pertama bernama Phaetusa, yang kedua Sweeper. Dari dua jiwa yang menghuni satu frame ini, yang satu penjaga terbaik umat manusia, yang lain mayat petarung dari Sangvis Ferri Manufacturing. \nMereka bertemu di tengah kobaran perang dan saling menyelamatkan, lalu memutuskan bergandengan tangan mengukir jalan mereka sendiri di era yang bergolak ini.

column1: A Doll who steps up to shoulder heavy responsibilities. She dedicates her time and energy to Griffin, while perfectly maintaining her individuality, thanks to her precise and efficient work planning. She never deviates, never breaks the rules; rather than changing the plan, she prefers to change reality.
column2: Doll yang maju memikul tanggung jawab berat. Dia mencurahkan waktu dan tenaganya untuk Griffin, sambil tetap menjaga jati dirinya dengan sempurna berkat perencanaan kerjanya yang presisi dan efisien. Dia tidak pernah menyimpang, tidak pernah melanggar aturan; alih-alih mengubah rencana, dia lebih suka mengubah kenyataan.

column1: A passionate, high-energy Doll with an optimistic outlook on life. As a gourmet hunter in the Yellow Zones, she's made it her mission to develop new ingredients to tackle food shortages. Standing against injustice is a way of life for her and her credo is to never let a conversation trail off. "While I can't say I approve of adding ketchup to Guo Bao Rou, if that's how you like it, then I suppose I can live with it."
column2: Doll yang bergairah dan penuh energi dengan pandangan hidup optimis. Sebagai pemburu kuliner di Yellow Zone, dia menjadikan pengembangan bahan pangan baru untuk mengatasi kelangkaan makanan sebagai misinya. Melawan ketidakadilan sudah jadi jalan hidupnya, dan pegangannya: jangan pernah biarkan obrolan mati di tengah jalan. "Aku memang tidak setuju menambahkan saus tomat ke Guo Bao Rou, tapi kalau kau memang suka begitu, ya kurasa aku bisa menerimanya."

column1: Robella is the very picture of decisiveness and swift action, but the truth is, she has been struggling with herself for a long time now, although it is not something others would see. Witnessing her sensitivity, kindness, and delicacy is a privilege for you and you alone. \n"If you're tired, you can leave the rest of the work to me... I don't want you to have to miss our briefing afterward, Commander."
column2: Robella adalah gambaran utuh dari ketegasan dan gerak cepat, tapi sebenarnya sudah lama dia bergulat dengan dirinya sendiri, meski itu bukan sesuatu yang terlihat orang lain. Menyaksikan kepekaan, kebaikan, dan kelembutannya adalah hak istimewa milikmu seorang. \n"Kalau kau lelah, sisa pekerjaannya serahkan padaku... Aku tidak mau kau sampai melewatkan briefing kita nanti, Komandan."

column1: A Doll passionate about culinary research and enjoying food, the kitchen is her new battlefield. Loves sharing her cooking process, though aroma may have boundaries, her smile spreads through the network, infecting every viewer.
column2: Doll yang bergairah meneliti kuliner dan menikmati makanan, dapur adalah medan tempur barunya. Dia suka membagikan proses memasaknya, dan meski aroma punya batas jangkauan, senyumnya menyebar lewat jaringan, menular ke setiap penonton.

column1: As both the founder and courier of "Ouka Kyuso", she is primarily active in the satellite cities and the contaminated zone around them. Together with her vehicle navigation system "colleague", they aim to make life a better place for the locals through speedy and efficient deliveries. Despite being introverted and unfortunate, her hardworking and diligent attitude has earned her the title of "Ace Courier". While she has grown into a capable professional, what truly makes her happy is the fact that she will be able to walk her future path with you by her side.\\n"If all this hard work wins me praise from the Commander... Then I guess I can work a little harder?"
column2: Sebagai pendiri sekaligus kurir "Ouka Kyuso", dia terutama beroperasi di kota-kota satelit dan zona terkontaminasi di sekitarnya. Bersama "rekan kerja" berupa sistem navigasi kendaraannya, mereka bertujuan membuat hidup warga setempat lebih baik lewat pengiriman yang cepat dan efisien. Meski tertutup dan sering sial, sikapnya yang pekerja keras dan tekun membuatnya menyandang gelar "Kurir Terbaik". Meski sudah tumbuh jadi profesional yang cakap, yang benar-benar membuatnya bahagia adalah kenyataan bahwa dia bisa menapaki jalan masa depannya dengan kau di sisinya.\\n"Kalau kerja keras ini membuatku dipuji Komandan... Ya kurasa aku bisa kerja sedikit lebih keras lagi?"

column1: An agile and cunning Doll who was once under the command of the Orlog Conglomerate. She was abandoned after failing an important mission and suffered severe damage to her neural cloud. The Elmo rescued her and she has become a reliable friend to the crew. \n"Compared to my previous colleagues, the Dolls around you seem a little... simpler."
column2: Doll yang gesit dan licik, dulu berada di bawah komando Orlog Conglomerate. Dia ditinggalkan setelah gagal menjalankan misi penting dan mengalami kerusakan parah pada Neural cloud-nya. Elmo menyelamatkannya dan dia menjadi teman yang bisa diandalkan bagi para kru. \n"Dibanding rekan-rekan kerjaku yang dulu, para Doll di sekitarmu kelihatan sedikit... lebih polos."

column1: A mischievous, impish Doll whose sweet smiles hide a cute cunning. She is hungry not only for the stage but also for the boundless adoration from her customers. ♥
column2: Doll usil dan jahil yang senyum manisnya menyembunyikan kelicikan yang menggemaskan. Dia lapar bukan hanya akan panggung, tapi juga akan pemujaan tanpa batas dari para pelanggannya. ♥

column1: An energetic and active Doll who loves to fight. Her thought process is simpler than most and she prefers doing things over thinking about them. She trusts her friends unconditionally and obeys your orders without question.\n"Commander, what are we going to do next? You haven't thought about it yet? In that case... Why don't we go out and have some fun—"
column2: Doll yang enerjik dan aktif serta gemar bertarung. Jalan pikirannya lebih sederhana dari kebanyakan orang dan dia lebih suka bertindak daripada memikirkannya. Dia memercayai teman-temannya tanpa syarat dan mematuhi perintahmu tanpa banyak tanya.\n"Komandan, kita mau apa selanjutnya? Belum kaupikirkan? Kalau begitu... Bagaimana kalau kita keluar dan bersenang-senang—"

column1: Gentle, strong, and understanding of others, she is a tactful and witty Doll who mingles well with different groups of people without allowing anyone to take advantage of her. Behind her tolerance lies an adherence to principles, that being Springfield's one and only principle—She shall always protect her friends and those who are important to her.
column2: Lembut, kuat, dan penuh pengertian, dia Doll yang cerdik dan bijak dalam bertutur, mudah berbaur dengan berbagai kalangan tanpa membiarkan siapa pun memanfaatkannya. Di balik toleransinya ada pegangan pada prinsip, dan itulah satu-satunya prinsip Springfield—Dia akan selalu melindungi teman-temannya dan orang-orang yang penting baginya.

column1: A cute, conscientious, and kind-hearted Doll who will do what it takes for a mission. She bravely steps forward for her companions in the Community whilst she wanders the lands in search of those she treasures dearly. You need not worry when entrusting her with assignments; she will never fail to meet your expectations or complete her missions.
column2: Doll yang menggemaskan, teliti, dan berhati baik, rela melakukan apa pun demi misinya. Dia dengan berani maju demi rekan-rekannya di Community sambil mengembara mencari orang-orang yang sangat dia sayangi. Kau tak perlu cemas menyerahkan tugas padanya; dia tidak akan pernah mengecewakan harapanmu atau gagal menuntaskan misinya.

column1: A serene Doll who finds solace under the starry sky. Hidden beneath her reticence is a delicate and sensitive soul. When the world slumbers, she confides in the vast cosmos and delights in the stars that seem to shine just for her.
column2: Doll yang tenang dan menemukan ketenteraman di bawah langit berbintang. Tersembunyi di balik sikap iritnya bicara adalah jiwa yang halus dan peka. Saat dunia terlelap, dia mencurahkan isi hatinya pada semesta yang luas dan menikmati bintang-bintang yang seakan bersinar hanya untuknya.

column1: A Doll with great ambitions. She draws friends to her side with her bold nature and strong decisiveness. However, she occasionally longs for a quiet corner to unload her burden and rest.
column2: Doll dengan ambisi besar. Dia menarik teman-teman ke sisinya lewat sifatnya yang berani dan ketegasannya yang kuat. Tapi sesekali dia merindukan sudut yang tenang untuk menurunkan bebannya dan beristirahat.

column1: A regularly pessimistic Doll. However, as the leader of H.I.D.E. 404's Team B, Vector will absolutely push through and endure till the very last moment with her teammates in the face of adversity, no matter how depressing the outcomes of her calculations.
column2: Doll yang biasanya pesimistis. Tapi sebagai pemimpin Team B H.I.D.E. 404, Vector pasti akan menerjang dan bertahan sampai detik terakhir bersama rekan-rekannya saat menghadapi kesulitan, sesuram apa pun hasil perhitungannya.

column1: An idol who shines on the unique stage, the "battlefield"! She prepares meticulously every day for her next performance—this way, she will not easily trip or bump into others again.
column2: Idol yang bersinar di panggung yang tak biasa, yaitu "medan tempur"! Dia bersiap dengan teliti setiap hari untuk penampilan berikutnya—dengan begitu dia tidak akan gampang tersandung atau menabrak orang lagi.

column1: No matter how difficult her mission is, Voymastina will always come up with a way to complete it. In her team, she is the sharpest blade, the strongest shield, and the most reliable linchpin of any plan that involves her. At times, you will be grateful that she's not on the opposing side.\\n"Tactics, efficiency, experience... each of them is essential to being the strongest Doll of them all."
column2: Sesulit apa pun misinya, Voymastina selalu menemukan cara menuntaskannya. Di timnya, dia bilah paling tajam, perisai paling kokoh, dan tumpuan paling bisa diandalkan dalam rencana apa pun yang melibatkannya. Kadang kau akan bersyukur dia tidak ada di pihak lawan.\\n"Taktik, efisiensi, pengalaman... ketiganya wajib dimiliki untuk jadi Doll terkuat di antara semuanya."

column1: No matter how difficult her mission, Voymastina will always come up with a way to complete it. In her team, she is the sharpest blade, the strongest shield, and the most reliable linchpin of any plan that involves her. At times, you will be grateful that she's not the one on the opposing side.\n"Tactics, efficiency, experience... Each of them is essential to being the strongest Doll of them all."
column2: Sesulit apa pun misinya, Voymastina selalu menemukan cara menuntaskannya. Di timnya, dia bilah paling tajam, perisai paling kokoh, dan tumpuan paling bisa diandalkan dalam rencana apa pun yang melibatkannya. Kadang kau akan bersyukur bukan dia yang ada di pihak lawan.\n"Taktik, efisiensi, pengalaman... Ketiganya wajib dimiliki untuk jadi Doll terkuat di antara semuanya."

column1: She's used to centering herself when she speaks and is quite harsh on her teammates. However, she deeply cherishes her friends and works hard to help everyone around her. She places great faith in her powers of discernment and is eager to pass judgement on people and things, while also taking action to uphold her sense of justice. She's very gentle deep down, but is bad at expressing her concern for others. This is a source of frustration for her and she needs her friends' acceptance and understanding. When her tough front is pierced, she reveals an unexpectedly cute side to her.
column2: Dia terbiasa menjadikan dirinya pusat saat bicara dan cukup keras pada rekan-rekan setimnya. Tapi dia sangat menyayangi teman-temannya dan bekerja keras membantu semua orang di sekitarnya. Dia sangat memercayai ketajaman penilaiannya dan gemar menghakimi orang maupun keadaan, sekaligus bertindak demi menegakkan rasa keadilannya. Jauh di dalam dia sangat lembut, tapi payah mengungkapkan kepeduliannya pada orang lain. Itu jadi sumber frustrasinya, dan dia butuh penerimaan serta pengertian teman-temannya. Begitu tameng kerasnya tertembus, dia menunjukkan sisi manis yang tak terduga.

column1: A passionate and responsible Doll who's devoted to the art of dancing. A compliment from the Commander set her on the path to becoming a dancer, and she founded the dancing troupe called "Sparkle Squad" to provide wandering Dolls with a place to call home and thus do justice to her position as a veteran Doll. She has never slacked off in her quest to perfect her art; diligence and willingness to learn are the cornerstones of her efforts while never giving up and keeping her eyes on the goals are the secret of her success. Don't question it, just trust her, because when she says she'll do it, she means it. "Keep up with the beat! Let's blow the roof off this place!"
column2: Doll yang bergairah dan bertanggung jawab serta mengabdikan diri pada seni tari. Sebuah pujian dari Komandan mengantarnya ke jalan menjadi penari, dan dia mendirikan sanggar tari bernama "Sparkle Squad" agar para Doll pengembara punya tempat yang bisa disebut rumah, sekaligus menunaikan perannya sebagai Doll senior. Dia tidak pernah kendur dalam usahanya menyempurnakan seninya; ketekunan dan kemauan belajar adalah fondasi kerjanya, sementara pantang menyerah dan tak melepas pandangan dari tujuan adalah rahasia suksesnya. Jangan diragukan, percaya saja padanya, karena kalau dia bilang akan melakukannya, dia serius. "Ikuti iramanya! Ayo kita bikin tempat ini heboh!"

column1: A stoic Doll with rich combat experience, she is unpretentious and decisive in action. As the leader of Monsoon Squad, she excels in combat and handling team affairs but is still a novice at lightening the mood. Don't hesitate to welcome her—a hero pursuing justice is always worthy of trust.
column2: Doll yang tabah dengan pengalaman tempur yang kaya, sederhana dan tegas dalam bertindak. Sebagai pemimpin Monsoon Squad, dia unggul dalam pertempuran dan mengurus tim, tapi masih pemula dalam mencairkan suasana. Jangan ragu menyambutnya—pahlawan yang mengejar keadilan selalu layak dipercaya.
